shared_elements: face-like features (eyes) rendered as bulging rounded forms
justification: A is a three-dimensional sculpture of a head or upper body with two large protruding rounded eyes under heavy brows, while B is a flat two-column grid of densely packed sign blocks, several containing small profile or frontal faces with eyes — the only real correspondence being the presence of stylised facial features. The organising principle differs completely: a single volumetric figure versus an ordered vertical sequence of framed, repeated glyph-like units read in paired columns.
